title: research(H_1617/H_1603 EXP-3 ARM-BIND toy): 🟠 DIRECTIONAL toy-SUPPORT — Hadamard binding op transfers into a learned trunk as ROBUSTNESS (not a categorical gap)
body: Fired the EXP-3 ARM-BIND precursor on pool GPU (summer RTX5070, torch CUDA, util 93% 실측). Trained a learned byte-LM trunk (causal Transformer d256/L4/H4, block11) with 3 param-fair readout arms on a compositional recombination task (scene = 3 obj × {8 shape, 8 color}, query-conjunction-present; 12 held-out conjunctions = seen parts in a novel binding), measured on the **binding-required (illusory-conjunction) HARD split** (pos=object (Qs,Qc) present, neg=Qs·Qc present separately but object absent; marginals identical → additive pooled rep provably can't separate). seeds {7,4302,4303}, steps 4000, 9 runs ~4min. **HARD acc: bind(Hadamard ⊙) 0.988±0.016 [1.0,0.965,1.0] · ctrl(plain linear) 0.778±0.208 [0.999,0.50,0.835] · bind_linear(⊙→+ param-matched) 0.828±0.232 [0.999,0.50,0.984].** Frozen mean bar met (bind−ctrl 0.21≥0.15 ∧ bind−linear 0.16≥0.15 = SUPPORT) but **seed-consistency 1/3** — honest framing: the lift is multiplicativity *robustness*, not an ability the trunk lacks. The attention trunk CAN pre-bind additively (ctrl seed7 0.999) but does so unstably (seed4302 collapses to chance 0.50); the param-matched additive control (bind_linear) collapses identically → the extra head/params don't help. Only Hadamard ⊙ is robust across all 3 seeds → the ⊙-vs-+ ablation isolates multiplicativity as the cause (H_1617 prediction confirmed). DIRECTIONAL torch toy (NOT engine-native, NOT 303M; a_engine_native_learning/a_toy_scale_recheck) — recommends (not auto-fires) wiring the coincidence op into the 303M mouth for the full EXP-3 decider (G1∧G6 engine-native, ~2× a 303M run). 2-surface: card H_1617 updated 🔵→🟠 + HYPOTHESES.jsonl; artifacts state/binding_arch_census/exp3_arm/ (PREREG.md · trainer.py · RESULT.md · RESULT.json · 9 ckpt pulled). enforce_anima_gates.py clean.
